Searge-SDXL：进化 v4.3.2

版本 4.x在这里。

我制作了一个方便的安装脚本，可以安装扩展和工作流程、Python 依赖项，并且还提供下载所需模型的选项。

请阅读安装说明自述文件有关安装脚本及其使用方法的更多信息。

描述

ComfyUI 的一些自定义节点和易于使用的 SDXL 1.0 工作流程。详细描述可以在项目存储库站点上找到，此处：GitHub 链接

安装中

详细的安装说明可以在这里找到：链接到 Github 上的自述文件

使用说明

工作流程位于工作流程文件夹，请从JSON 文件以确保您使用的是它的最新版本。

的图片在示例文件夹嵌入了工作流程。

如何使用此工作流程

这是 Nerdy Rodent 制作的关于 3.4 版本工作流程的精彩 Youtube 视频。 v4.0 中发生了很多变化，但基本原理仍然适用。当您观看时，请不要忘记订阅该频道。

链接到“书呆子啮齿动物”视频

更新

v4.3.2 有什么新功能？

这是一个小更新，旨在使工作流程和自定义节点扩展与 ComfyUI 中的最新更改兼容。

v4.3.1 有什么新功能？

这是一个小更新，旨在使工作流程和自定义节点扩展与 ComfyUI 中的最新更改兼容。

v4.3 有什么新功能？

除了 FreeU v1 之外，此更新还添加了对 FreeU v2 的支持。

新功能

  • 添加了对 FreeU v2 的支持并包含在 v4.3 工作流程中

  • 为 FreeU 添加了更多预设以及在 v1 和 v2 之间切换的选择器

  • 更新了示例图像以嵌入 v4.3 工作流程

v4.2 有什么新功能？

此更新包含错误修复，解决了 v4.0 发布后发现的问题。

错误修复

  • ComfyUI 最近的更改与我的修复实现相冲突，现在已修复，修复应该
    再次工作

新功能

  • 添加了对 FreeU 的支持并包含在 v4.2 工作流程中

  • 注意：示例文件夹中的图像仍然嵌入 v4.1 的工作流程，使用 FreeU 加载新的
    工作流程从.json文件在工作流程文件夹

v4.1 有什么新功能？

此更新包含错误修复，解决了 v4.0 发布后发现的问题。

错误修复

  • 高分辨率潜在细节器未在处理管道中正确设置并且不执行任何操作

  • 调试打印机节点已损坏 - 我没有注意到这一点，因为它未在任何 v4.0 工作流程中连接

  • 与批量大小大于 1 的生成相关的错误已修复，现在可以正常工作

其他变化

  • 中的图像例子文件夹已更新以嵌入 v4.1 工作流程

v4.0 有什么新功能？

  • 一个完全重写自定义节点扩展和 SDXL 工作流程

  • 高度优化处理管道，现在速度提高 20%比旧的工作流程版本

  • 支持控制网和修订版, 最多可以同时应用 5 个

  • 多LoRAsupport with up to 5 LoRA's at once

  • 更好的图像质量在许多情况下，对 SDXL 采样器进行了一些改进，可以生成图像
    具有更高的质量

  • 改进高分辨率取代旧的“高分辨率修复”的模式，应该会生成更好的图像

  • ...还有更多的事情，太多了，无法在这里一一列举

Searge-SDXL: EVOLVED v4.3.2

Version 4.xis here.

I made a convenient install script that can install the extension and workflow, the python dependencies, and it also offer the option to download the required models.

Please read the install instructions inthe readme filefor more information about the install script and how to use it.

Description

Some custom nodes for ComfyUI and an easy to use SDXL 1.0 workflow. A detailed description can be found on the project repository site, here:Github Link

Installing

Detailed install instruction can be found here:Link to the readme file on Github

Usage Notes

The workflow is in theworkflowfolder, please load it from theJSON filesto make sure you are using the latest versions of it.

Theimagesin theexamples folderhave workflows embedded.

How to use this workflow

Here is an amazing Youtube video that Nerdy Rodent made about version 3.4 of the workflow. Many things have changed in v4.0 but the basics still apply. And while you are watching it, don't forget to subscribe to the channel.

Link to the Nerdy Rodent video

Updates

What's new in v4.3.2?

This is a minor update to make the workflow and custom node extension compatible with the latest changes in ComfyUI.

What's new in v4.3.1?

This is a minor update to make the workflow and custom node extension compatible with the latest changes in ComfyUI.

What's new in v4.3?

This update added support for FreeU v2 in addition to FreeU v1.

New Features

  • Support for FreeU v2 has been added and is included in the v4.3 workflow

  • Added more presets for FreeU and a selector to switch between v1 and v2

  • Updated the example images to embed the v4.3 workflow

What's new in v4.2?

This update contains bug fixes that address issues found after v4.0 was released.

Bug Fixes

  • A recent change in ComfyUI conflicted with my implementation of inpainting, this is now fixed and inpainting should
    work again

New Features

  • Support for FreeU has been added and is included in the v4.2 workflow

  • Note:the images in the example folder are still embedding v4.1 of the workflow, to use FreeU load the new
    workflow from the.jsonfile in theworkflowfolder

What's new in v4.1?

This update contains bug fixes that address issues found after v4.0 was released.

Bug Fixes

  • The high resolution latent detailer was not properly set up in the processing pipeline and did nothing

  • The debug printer node was broken - I didn't notice that because it was not connected in any of the v4.0 workflows

  • A bug related to generating with batch sizes larger than 1 has been fixed, it's now working properly

Other Changes

  • The images in theexamplesfolder have been updated to embed the v4.1 workflow

What's new in v4.0?

  • Acomplete re-writeof the custom node extension and the SDXL workflow

  • Highly optimizedprocessing pipeline, nowup to 20% fasterthan in older workflow versions

  • Support forControlnet and Revision, up to 5 can be applied together

  • Multi-LoRAsupport with up to 5 LoRA's at once

  • Better Image Qualityin many cases, some improvements to the SDXL sampler were made that can produce images
    with higher quality

  • ImprovedHigh Resolutionmodes that replace the old "Hi-Res Fix" and should generate better images

  • ... many more things, too many to mention them all here
